City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
February 21, 2012
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation by the West Basin Municipal Water District Director Carol Kwan to selected Lomita businesses for demonstrating their dedication to environmentally sound business practices and their efforts to use water more efficiently.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes - February 6 and January 17
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report recommending authorization to advertise the city's water rights for lease for 2011/12. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
e.
Report submitting recommendation to approve red curb on southbound Eshelman Avenue approaching 240th Street to facilitate bike path. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
f.
Report submitting recommending to install a commercial loading zone on the west side of Cypress Street south of Pacific Coast Highway. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Second reading and adoption of Ordinance No 249 to amend the contract between the City Council and the Board of Administration of the California Public Employees' Retirement System to provide for second tier retirement benefit to new employees. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report submitted resolution reaffirming employer paid member contributions under the California Public Employees' Retirement System. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
6.
RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD AND MUSEUM FOUNDATION BOARD Report requesting additional information for the merger of the Railroad Museum Board and the Railroad Museum Foundation Executive Board.
Presented by Asst City Mgr Sugano.
7.CO
MMISSION APPOINTMENTS/REDUCING NUMBER OF COMMISSIONERS Report recommending appointments to fill vacancies on the Planning Commission (1), the Railroad Foundation Executive Board (3) and Public Safety and Traffic Commission (2) and discussion and possible action on reducing the number of commissioners on 7 member commissions.
Presented by City Manager Tomita
8.
SCHEDULE MEETING DATE Report recommending that a date and time be scheduled to discuss the pavement management plan, capital improvements program and water bond rating.
Presented by City Manager Tomita.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
